name: KACD: HSIC + variance ANM ordering
tagline: Greedy source-finding with a dual HSIC + normalized residual-variance score, GBR parent selection, and partial-HSIC pruning.

key_hyperparams.name: n_est_light
key_hyperparams.role: GBR trees in ordering & pruning (low / high sample)

key_hyperparams.name: swap_thresh
key_hyperparams.role: ordering swap threshold on direction score

key_hyperparams.name: imp_threshold
key_hyperparams.role: GBR feature-importance cutoff for parent inclusion

key_hyperparams.name: base_thresh
key_hyperparams.role: min importance for parent (high / low sample)

diff_from_baseline: Replaces CAM's pure residual-variance ordering with an HSIC-weighted combined score, and replaces NOTEARS' acyclicity loss entirely; pruning step swaps NOTEARS' linear-correlation residual test for partial-residual HSIC and adds an explicit pairwise-direction reordering pass on top of CAM-style GBR parent selection.

name: Basis-feature ANM with sink peeling
tagline: Closed-form rank-basis dependence score drives pairwise asymmetry, sink-peeling order, ExtraTrees screening, and forward-backward parent selection.

key_hyperparams.name: GBR n_estimators
key_hyperparams.role: scaled by parent count and sample size

key_hyperparams.name: screen_k
key_hyperparams.role: max candidate parents after pairwise screen

key_hyperparams.name: max_pa
key_hyperparams.role: max parents per node (small-n vs large-n)

diff_from_baseline: Replaces both CAM's residual-variance ordering and NOTEARS' continuous DAG constraint with a basis-feature dependence surrogate plus iterative residualized sink peeling; uses cross-fit GBR residuals and rank-uniformized polynomial+trig features instead of HSIC, and combines forward-backward search with a GBR-importance union step.

name: Empty-graph stub
tagline: Returns the all-zeros adjacency before any analysis; the elaborate ANM/HSIC/CAM pipeline below it is dead code.
diff_from_baseline: Effectively predicts no edges, so it underperforms every baseline (CAM, NOTEARS-MLP, DirectLiNGAM, GraN-DAG) on F1/recall and posts SHD equal to the number of true edges; the rich algorithmic body following the early `return` is never executed.
